instruction: How to add a filter to match by source IP
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip src 10.0.0.1 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a filter to match by destination IP
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip dst 192.168.1.100 flowid 1:20

instruction: How to add a filter to match by TCP port
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip dport 80 0xffff flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a filter to match by UDP port
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip sport 53 0xffff flowid 1:20

instruction: How to add a filter to match by DSCP value
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip tos 0x10 0xfc flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a u32 filter to match by protocol
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip protocol 6 0xff flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a u32 filter with match on any IP
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip dst 0.0.0.0/0 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a u32 filter with source port range
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip sport 1024 0xfff8 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add an fw filter to match firewall mark
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 handle 1 fw flowid 1:10

instruction: How to add a filter that redirects to ifb
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match u32 0 0 action mirred egress redirect dev ifb0

instruction: How to add an ingress qdisc
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 ingress

instruction: How to add a filter on ingress qdisc
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent ffff: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip src 10.0.0.1 action drop

instruction: How to add an ifb interface for ingress shaping
output: modprobe ifb && ip link set ifb0 up && tc qdisc add dev eth0 ingress && tc filter add dev eth0 parent ffff: protocol ip u32 match u32 0 0 action mirred egress redirect dev ifb0

instruction: How to shape ingress traffic via ifb
output: tc qdisc add dev ifb0 root handle 1: htb default 30 && tc class add dev ifb0 parent 1: classid 1:10 htb rate 5mbit

instruction: How to add a filter to limit ICMP traffic
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip protocol 1 0xff flowid 1:20

instruction: How to add a cgroup filter for tc
output: tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip prio 1 cgroup match cgroup 1 flowid 1:10

instruction: How to set up qdisc with SFQ (Stochastic Fairness Queueing)
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root sfq perturb 10

instruction: How to set up qdisc with ESFQ
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root esfq perturb 10 hash ip

instruction: How to add a RED (Random Early Detection) qdisc
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root red min 5000 max 15000 probability 0.02 limit 30000 avpkt 1000 bandwidth 10mbit

instruction: How to add a GRED qdisc
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root gred setup DPs 3 default 2 grio

instruction: How to add a TAPRIO qdisc for time-aware scheduling
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root taprio num_tc 4 map 2 2 1 0 3 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 queues 1@0 1@1 1@2 1@3 base-time 0 sched-entry S 01 1000000 sched-entry S 02 2000000 flags 0x2

instruction: How to add an ETS (Enhanced Transmission Selection) qdisc
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root ets strict 3 priomap 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7

instruction: How to add a MQPRIO qdisc for multiqueue devices
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root mqprio num_tc 8 map 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 queues 1@0 1@1 1@2 1@3 1@4 1@5 1@6 1@7 hw 1

instruction: How to add a CAKE qdisc for bandwidth shaping
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root cake bandwidth 10mbit

instruction: How to set CAKE to diffserv
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root cake bandwidth 10mbit diffserv
